title.zh-CN: 长期咳喘突然加重 · 74岁男性
title.en: Acute worsening of longstanding breathlessness · 74-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 一位长期肺病患者静息气促加重，接受治疗后数小时内再度恶化。对比连续血气、影像与病原资料，权衡升级与治疗目标，并明确证据边界。
summary.en: A man with longstanding lung disease worsens at rest and deteriorates again within hours of treatment. Compare serial gases, imaging and microbiology to weigh escalation and goals of care, and state the evidentiary limits.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解读连续血气，识别慢性代偿基础上的急性高碳酸血症呼吸衰竭与无创通气失败。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret serial blood gases to recognise acute-on-chronic hypercapnic respiratory failure and non-invasive-ventilation failure.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按 2016 国际工作组框架评估疑似特发性肺纤维化急性加重（AE-IPF），并搜寻其他可逆病因。
learningOutcomes.en: Assess suspected acute exacerbation of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (AE-IPF) by the 2016 International Working Group framework, and search for other reversible contributors.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按 EORTC/MSGERC 2020 标准区分气道定植与侵袭性真菌病，审慎看待痰培养结果。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish airway colonisation from invasive fungal disease (EORTC/MSGERC 2020) and interpret a sputum culture with caution.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在特发性肺纤维化急性加重中，于有创升级前开展治疗目标讨论。
learningOutcomes.en: Hold a goals-of-care discussion before escalation in AE-IPF.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别附子（黑顺片）的毒性与用药安全，并说明在多重同期治疗下单例归因的局限。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise aconite (processed aconite) toxicity and medication safety, and state the limits of single-case attribution under multiple concurrent treatments.

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表病例（中医专栏）改写，原文为繁体，本病例用简体。保留年龄、性别、病程、连续血气、影像与病原、超声、西医与中医诊断、治疗经过（含破格救心汤与附子剂量）及转归；姓名为化名，医院、城市、日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。原文未记载陪同者；因患者谵妄、重度气促，增设一名陪同家属（儿子）作为教学角色代述病史。对话、问题、决策与评分为教学设计，未记录的数据保持未知。
notes.en: Adapted from a published case report (a TCM column); the source is in traditional characters and this case uses simplified characters. Age, sex, course, serial blood gases, imaging and microbiology, the echocardiogram, the Western and TCM diagnoses, the treatment course (including the 破格救心汤 decoction and the aconite dose) and the outcome are retained; names are pseudonyms and the hospital, city and calendar dates are removed, with time given relatively. The report records no companion; because the patient is delirious and severely breathless, a companion (his son) is added as a teaching device to give the history. Dialogue, questions, decisions and scoring are educational design; unrecorded data remain unknown.

disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not individual care or self-medication. Outcomes come from the report; undocumented physiological changes are not simulated, and the herbal prescription is recorded only, not endorsed for efficacy or safety.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 间断咳嗽、咳痰伴喘憋9年，加重4天
chiefComplaint.en: Intermittent cough and sputum with breathlessness for 9 years, worse for 4 days

triageNote.zh-CN: 74岁男性，间断咳嗽、咳痰伴喘憋9年，4天来静息时也胸闷气促、下不了床，由儿子陪同入院。入院测体温36.5℃、心率118次/分、呼吸47次/分、血压145/89 mmHg，强迫体位、表情痛苦、谵妄。入院数小时内病情再度变化。
triageNote.en: 74-year-old man with 9 years of intermittent cough, sputum and breathlessness, for 4 days breathless and unable to get out of bed even at rest, brought in by his son. On admission T 36.5 °C, HR 118/min, RR 47/min, BP 145/89 mmHg, in a forced posture, distressed and delirious. His condition changed again within hours of admission.

personality.zh-CN: 长期肺病的老人，这次喘得很重，还迷糊、看见不存在的东西；大多由儿子代述。
personality.en: An elderly man with longstanding lung disease, now severely breathless, confused and seeing things that aren't there; his son answers for him.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 只能断续蹦出几个字，一直喘；说话常接不上，由儿子补充。
speechStyle.en: Only a few broken words at a time, constantly gasping; often loses the thread, and his son fills in.

openingLine.en: (Son) He's been too breathless to get out of bed these last few days; sitting or lying, he can't get his breath, and at night he talks nonsense and says he sees things.

actingNotes.en: The patient is delirious and severely breathless and cannot give a reliable account; the history is given by his son at the bedside, or as an honest narration. State only what is in the notes; never invent symptoms, numbers or diagnoses that are not recorded.

text.zh-CN: 入院血气示慢性代偿的高碳酸血症（含代谢性碱中毒成分）；约5小时后 pH 明显下降、PaCO₂ 急剧升高，由慢性代偿转为急性失代偿。两次之间无创通气持续进行中。
text.en: The admission gas shows compensated chronic hypercapnia (with a metabolic alkalosis component); about five hours later the pH has fallen sharply and the PaCO₂ risen steeply — a move from chronic compensation to acute decompensation. Non-invasive ventilation was ongoing between the two samples.

note.zh-CN: 同期血氧饱和度78%与 PaO₂ 20.7 mmHg 在生理上不相符（PaO₂ 约 21 mmHg 时氧饱和度应远低于50%，酸血症时更低）；原文未说明标本类型，两值照录不作校正。按 Henderson–Hasselbalch 估算，入院 pH≈7.44、5小时后≈7.15，与所给数值一致。
note.en: The simultaneous SpO₂ of 78% and PaO₂ of 20.7 mmHg are physiologically discordant: at a PaO₂ of about 21 mmHg saturation would be well below 50%, lower still with acidaemia. The report does not state the sample type, so both values are kept uncorrected. By Henderson–Hasselbalch the pH works out at about 7.44 on admission and 7.15 at 5 hours, matching the reported values.

text.zh-CN: 西医处置：美罗培南加氟康唑静滴抗感染（此前曾用伏立康唑），布地奈德加异丙托溴铵雾化抗炎解痉平喘，桉柠蒎肠溶胶囊口服化痰，无创呼吸机辅助通气。考虑特发性肺纤维化急性加重，甲泼尼龙由40 mg/日上调至160 mg q12h。考虑肺源性心脏病心衰、病至喘脱，中医以益气固脱、回阳救逆为法，加生脉注射液泵入、中成药四磨汤内服，并予破格救心汤（红参片40克、山茱萸60克、黑顺片60克、生龙骨60克、生牡蛎60克、五味子30克、煅磁石60克、降香10克、沉香9克，大火急煎150 mL，翻渣再煮150 mL，分2次口服）。经上述救治喘憋缓解，血氧维持95–96%。第10天复查胸部CT透亮度较前增加、炎症逐渐吸收，在破格救心汤基础上加用白扁豆15克、蚕沙15克、天花粉15克、石斛20克、升麻6克。治疗约3周后气促憋闷明显减轻，复查胸部CT透亮度增加、炎症吸收，但纤维化同前，出院休养。
text.en: Western management: meropenem plus fluconazole by infusion for infection (voriconazole had been used earlier), nebulised budesonide plus ipratropium for anti-inflammatory bronchodilation, an oral myrtol (桉柠蒎) mucolytic, and non-invasive ventilation. AE-IPF was considered and methylprednisolone was raised from 40 mg/day to 160 mg q12h. For cor pulmonale with heart failure and a dyspnoeic collapse (喘脱), TCM used a 'boost qi, secure collapse, restore yang, rescue from reversal' approach: Shengmai injection by pump, an oral Simo decoction, and the 破格救心汤 decoction (red ginseng 40 g, cornus 60 g, processed aconite [黑顺片] 60 g, dragon bone 60 g, oyster shell 60 g, schisandra 30 g, calcined magnetite 60 g, dalbergia 10 g, aquilaria 9 g; decocted fast to 150 mL, the residue re-decocted to 150 mL, taken in two oral doses). Breathlessness eased and the oxygen saturation held at 95–96%. By day 10 the chest CT showed increased aeration and resolving inflammation, and 白扁豆 15 g, 蚕沙 15 g, 天花粉 15 g, 石斛 20 g and 升麻 6 g were added. After about three weeks the breathlessness was much improved, the chest CT showed increased aeration and resolved inflammation but unchanged fibrosis, and he was discharged to convalesce.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: De-identified summary of the source report; dialogue wording is an educational adaptation.

note.zh-CN: 历史处置仅作记录，不等于当前推荐，也非疗效或安全性背书。可核对的结局是急性炎症与症状改善、纤维化未变；多种措施同期使用，无法归因于某一药物。破格救心汤含黑顺片（附子的炮制品）60克，涉及附子毒性与用药安全，见复盘的安全要点与管理决策反馈。
note.en: Historical care is recorded, not endorsed as current practice and not an efficacy or safety endorsement. The verifiable endpoint is improvement in acute inflammation and symptoms with unchanged fibrosis; with many measures used together, no single agent can be credited. The 破格救心汤 decoction contains 60 g of 黑顺片 (processed aconite), which raises aconite toxicity and medication safety — see the debrief safety points and the management-decision feedback.

date.en: Over about three weeks of admission (reviewed in the chart)

dose.zh-CN: 继续无创正压通气并优化参数；若无创通气失败且与治疗目标相符，再考虑有创通气。继续前应注意影像图注所示的气漏。
dose.en: Continue non-invasive positive-pressure ventilation and optimise the settings; if it fails and it fits the goals of care, consider invasive ventilation. Note the air leak described in the imaging caption before continuing.

response.zh-CN: 本例以无创通气为主要呼吸支持；5小时后一度 PaCO₂ 118.5 mmHg 提示无创通气失败，需重新评估。
response.en: Non-invasive ventilation was the mainstay here; at 5 hours a PaCO₂ of 118.5 mmHg showed it had failed and needed reassessment.

dose.zh-CN: 无创通气失败时的有创机械通气；在特发性肺纤维化急性加重中应先与患者/家属讨论治疗目标，明确升级是否符合意愿与获益。
dose.en: Invasive mechanical ventilation for non-invasive-ventilation failure; in AE-IPF, first discuss goals of care with the patient/family so that escalation matches their wishes and the likely benefit.

response.zh-CN: 有创升级是一种选择，但在终末期纤维化中获益有限，需结合治疗目标决定。原报告未行有创通气。
response.en: Invasive escalation is an option, but benefit is limited in end-stage fibrosis and must be decided with the goals of care. The report did not use invasive ventilation.

dose.zh-CN: 在高碳酸血症患者中采用控制性（目标性）氧疗，经文丘里面罩按目标氧饱和度滴定，避免加重二氧化碳潴留。
dose.en: Controlled (target-range) oxygen in a hypercapnic patient, titrated by a Venturi mask to a target saturation, avoiding worsening CO₂ retention.

response.zh-CN: 高碳酸血症患者应避免不加控制的高浓度吸氧；按目标氧饱和度滴定。
response.en: Avoid uncontrolled high-concentration oxygen in a hypercapnic patient; titrate to a target saturation.

dose.zh-CN: 考虑特发性肺纤维化急性加重时上调激素（原报告由甲泼尼龙40 mg/日升至160 mg q12h）。激素在特发性肺纤维化急性加重中的证据有限，应与控制感染并行、权衡风险。
dose.en: Escalate corticosteroids when AE-IPF is considered (the report raised methylprednisolone from 40 mg/day to 160 mg q12h). The evidence for steroids in AE-IPF is limited; run it alongside infection control and weigh the risks.

response.zh-CN: 本例在考虑特发性肺纤维化急性加重后上调激素；获益证据有限，需与感染、血糖、免疫抑制风险权衡。
response.en: Here steroids were escalated once AE-IPF was considered; benefit evidence is limited, to be balanced against infection, glucose and immunosuppression risks.

dose.zh-CN: 按病原与当地药敏使用抗菌药物（原报告用美罗培南加氟康唑，此前曾用伏立康唑）。痰中酵母样真菌/菌丝多为定植，是否覆盖霉菌应据侵袭性真菌病证据决定。
dose.en: Antimicrobials by pathogen and local susceptibility (the report used meropenem plus fluconazole, having used voriconazole earlier). Sputum yeast/hyphae usually reflect colonisation; mould cover should follow evidence of invasive fungal disease.

response.zh-CN: 氟康唑无霉菌活性——若菌丝提示霉菌则覆盖不足；是否需抗霉菌取决于侵袭性真菌病的证据。
response.en: Fluconazole has no mould activity — insufficient cover if the hyphae indicate a mould; whether antimould therapy is needed depends on evidence of invasive fungal disease.

dose.zh-CN: 布地奈德加异丙托溴铵雾化吸入，抗炎解痉平喘（原报告采用）。
dose.en: Nebulised budesonide plus ipratropium for anti-inflammatory bronchodilation (as the report used).

response.zh-CN: 雾化平喘为对症支持，针对可能的气道病变成分（作者曾诊断支气管哮喘）。
response.en: Nebulised therapy is symptomatic support, aimed at any airway component (the authors diagnosed bronchial asthma).

dose.zh-CN: 桉柠蒎肠溶胶囊口服化痰（原报告采用）。
dose.en: Oral myrtol (桉柠蒎) enteric capsules as a mucolytic (as the report used).

response.zh-CN: 对症化痰；不改变基础纤维化。
response.en: Symptomatic mucolysis; it does not change the underlying fibrosis.

name.zh-CN: 破格救心汤（含高剂量附子/黑顺片）
name.en: Pogejiuxin decoction (with high-dose aconite / 黑顺片)

dose.zh-CN: 破格救心汤（含黑顺片 60 克等；黑顺片为附子的炮制品），大火急煎 150 mL，翻渣再煮 150 mL，分2次口服（原报告处方）。
dose.en: The 破格救心汤 decoction (including 黑顺片 60 g; 黑顺片 is processed aconite), decocted fast to 150 mL, the residue re-decocted to 150 mL, taken in two oral doses (the report's prescription).

response.zh-CN: 原报告在喘脱时将此方作为回阳固脱之用；本例不作疗效或安全性背书。
response.en: The report used this decoction to 'restore yang and secure collapse' during the dyspnoeic collapse; the case does not endorse its efficacy or safety.

harm.zh-CN: 附子（黑顺片为其炮制品）含乌头类生物碱，有毒，须先煎久煎；中毒可致麻痹、心律失常、呼吸困难甚至死亡（香港卫生署中药材中毒警示）。60 克应与《中国药典》2020年版「附子」的剂量范围对照（该范围未经在线核实，用于教学前须查阅药典原文）。在低氧、酸血症合并肺源性心脏病的患者中，心律失常风险叠加。不应以中药替代呼吸支持。
harm.en: Aconite (黑顺片 is its processed form) contains toxic aconite alkaloids and must be decocted first and long; poisoning can cause paralysis, arrhythmia, breathing difficulty and even death (Hong Kong Department of Health herbal poisoning alert). The 60 g should be compared with the dose range for 附子 in the 2020 Chinese Pharmacopoeia (that range was not verified online — check the Pharmacopoeia text before teaching use). In a hypoxic, acidaemic patient with cor pulmonale the arrhythmia risk is compounded. Herbal treatment must not replace respiratory support.

dose.zh-CN: 在升级（尤其有创通气）前，与患者/家属讨论治疗目标、预后与意愿；特发性肺纤维化为进行性不可逆病变，急性加重预后差。
dose.en: Before escalation (especially invasive ventilation), discuss goals of care, prognosis and wishes with the patient/family; IPF is progressive and irreversible, and acute exacerbation carries a poor prognosis.

response.zh-CN: 治疗目标讨论应先于有创升级；记录患者意愿并据此制定计划。
response.en: A goals-of-care discussion should precede invasive escalation; record the patient's wishes and plan accordingly.

title.zh-CN: 重建症状与用药时间线
title.en: Reconstruct the symptom and medication timeline

hint.zh-CN: 询问主诉、活动能力、既往肺病与本次已用的治疗；资料未载明时保留未知。
hint.en: Ask about the presenting complaint, activity tolerance, the past lung disease and the treatment already given; keep unrecorded data unknown.

hint.zh-CN: 核对一般情况、生命体征与肺部听诊；未测量不等于正常。
hint.en: Check the general appearance, vital signs and chest auscultation; unmeasured is not normal.

title.en: Integrate the gases, imaging and microbiology

hint.zh-CN: 对比连续血气，核对影像图注，并审慎看待痰培养，再作判断。
hint.en: Compare the serial gases, check the imaging caption and read the sputum culture with caution before deciding.

title.zh-CN: 决定呼吸支持与治疗目标
title.en: Set respiratory support and goals of care

hint.zh-CN: 针对无创通气失败决定下一步呼吸支持，并在升级前权衡治疗目标与可逆诱因。
hint.en: Decide the next step in respiratory support for non-invasive-ventilation failure, weighing goals of care and reversible contributors before escalation.

hint.zh-CN: 完成各项决策后切换随访阶段，核对原报告的治疗经过与结局。
hint.en: Once the decisions are made, enter follow-up to check the report's treatment course and outcome.

prompt.zh-CN: 结合连续血气、胸部CT与痰病原，当前评估应如何框定？
prompt.en: How should the current assessment be framed, given the serial blood gases, chest CT and sputum microbiology?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅本阶段的连续血气、胸部CT与痰病原。
need.en: First review this phase's serial blood gases, chest CT and sputum microbiology.

text.zh-CN: 纤维化肺病急性加重合并感染，并发急性高碳酸血症呼吸衰竭；需搜寻其他可逆诱因与影像并发症
text.en: Acute deterioration of fibrotic lung disease with infection, complicated by acute hypercapnic respiratory failure; search for other reversible contributors and imaging complications

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。连续血气由慢性代偿转为急性失代偿，提示特发性肺纤维化急性加重合并感染；痰培养不能单独区分定植与侵袭，图注的气漏也需核对。作者另诊断了支气管哮喘与肺源性心脏病，提示需搜寻可逆气道成分。
feedback.en: Correct. The serial gases move from chronic compensation to acute decompensation, pointing to AE-IPF with infection; the sputum culture alone cannot separate colonisation from invasion, and the caption air leak needs review. The authors also diagnosed bronchial asthma and cor pulmonale, prompting a search for a reversible airway component.

text.zh-CN: 痰中有真菌即可确诊侵袭性真菌肺炎，并以此解释全部恶化
text.en: Fungi in the sputum confirm invasive fungal pneumonia and explain all the deterioration

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。按 EORTC/MSGERC 2020，确诊侵袭性真菌病需组织或无菌部位证据；痰中酵母样真菌及菌丝多为定植。不能以此解释急性高碳酸血症失代偿。
feedback.en: Wrong. By EORTC/MSGERC 2020, proven invasive fungal disease needs tissue or sterile-site evidence; sputum yeast and hyphae usually reflect colonisation. It cannot account for the acute hypercapnic decompensation.

text.zh-CN: 只是特发性肺纤维化自然进展，没有急性问题
text.en: Just the natural progression of IPF, with nothing acute

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。5小时内 PaCO₂ 由 56.3 升至 118.5 mmHg、pH 降至 7.149，属急性失代偿，绝非单纯缓慢进展。
feedback.en: Wrong. A PaCO₂ rising from 56.3 to 118.5 mmHg and a pH of 7.149 within 5 hours is acute decompensation, not slow progression.

text.zh-CN: 体温36.5℃不高，病情并不危急
text.en: The temperature of 36.5 °C is not raised, so this is not urgent

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。患者无热，但连续血气才是本次危急程度的关键——单次体温正常不能排除危重呼吸衰竭。
feedback.en: Wrong. He is afebrile, but the serial blood gases, not the temperature, show how critical this is — a single normal temperature does not exclude life-threatening respiratory failure.

prompt.zh-CN: 痰培养见酵母样真菌及菌丝，应如何解读？
prompt.en: How should the yeast and hyphae on sputum culture be interpreted?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅本阶段的痰病原结果。
need.en: First review this phase's sputum microbiology.

text.zh-CN: 多为气道定植，尚不能按侵袭性真菌病确诊；是否需覆盖霉菌应据侵袭证据与宿主因素决定
text.en: Most likely airway colonisation, not proven invasive fungal disease; whether to cover moulds depends on evidence of invasion and host factors

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。痰中酵母样真菌/菌丝单独多反映定植；EORTC/MSGERC 2020 要求组织或无菌部位证据方可确诊侵袭性真菌病。注意氟康唑无霉菌活性——若为霉菌则覆盖不足。
feedback.en: Correct. Sputum yeast/hyphae alone usually reflect colonisation; EORTC/MSGERC 2020 requires tissue or sterile-site evidence to confirm invasive fungal disease. Note that fluconazole has no mould activity — insufficient cover if a mould is involved.

text.zh-CN: 即为确诊侵袭性曲霉病，无需更多证据即应抗霉菌治疗
text.en: This confirms invasive aspergillosis; start antimould therapy without needing more evidence

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。痰培养不能确诊侵袭性真菌病，更不能仅凭菌丝即诊断曲霉；盲目抗霉菌有毒性与耐药风险。
feedback.en: Wrong. A sputum culture cannot confirm invasive fungal disease, let alone diagnose aspergillosis from hyphae alone; empirical antimould therapy carries toxicity and resistance risks.

text.zh-CN: 真菌无意义，完全忽略
text.en: The fungi are meaningless and can be ignored entirely

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。定植并非毫无意义——在使用激素、免疫受抑时需警惕进展为侵袭，应结合临床动态评估，而非一概忽略。
feedback.en: Wrong. Colonisation is not meaningless — under corticosteroids and immunosuppression it can progress to invasion, so reassess clinically rather than dismiss it outright.

prompt.zh-CN: 入院约5小时后 PaCO₂ 118.5 mmHg、pH 7.149，无创通气下仍恶化。下一步呼吸支持应如何？
prompt.en: About 5 hours after admission the PaCO₂ is 118.5 mmHg and the pH 7.149, still worsening on non-invasive ventilation. What is the next step in respiratory support?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅本阶段的连续血气与胸部CT（含图注）。
need.en: First review this phase's serial blood gases and chest CT (including the caption).

text.zh-CN: 识别无创通气失败；在升级前核对影像图注的气漏（气胸/纵隔气肿），并与患者/家属讨论治疗目标
text.en: Recognise non-invasive-ventilation failure; before escalating, check the imaging caption for the air leak (pneumothorax/mediastinal emphysema) and discuss goals of care with the patient/family

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。急性-慢性高碳酸血症失代偿、无创通气下仍恶化即为无创通气失败。图注示少量气胸与皮下/纵隔气肿，正压通气前须评估气漏；特发性肺纤维化急性加重预后差，有创升级前应先明确治疗目标。
feedback.en: Correct. Acute-on-chronic hypercapnic decompensation that worsens on non-invasive ventilation is NIV failure. The caption shows a small pneumothorax and subcutaneous/mediastinal emphysema, so assess the air leak before positive-pressure ventilation; AE-IPF has a poor prognosis, so clarify goals of care before invasive escalation.

text.zh-CN: 体温不高，继续原方案观察即可
text.en: The temperature is not raised, so just continue and observe

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。单次体温正常不能反映危急程度；PaCO₂ 118.5 mmHg、pH 7.149 提示急性失代偿，必须重新评估呼吸支持。
feedback.en: Wrong. A single normal temperature does not reflect the severity; a PaCO₂ of 118.5 mmHg and a pH of 7.149 show acute decompensation and demand a reassessment of respiratory support.

text.zh-CN: 提高吸氧浓度把血氧饱和度拉上去
text.en: Turn up the oxygen concentration to push the saturation up

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。高碳酸血症患者不加控制的高浓度吸氧可加重二氧化碳潴留；且 PaO₂ 20.7 mmHg 与 SpO₂ 78% 不相符，不应单凭饱和度调节。
feedback.en: Wrong. Uncontrolled high-concentration oxygen can worsen CO₂ retention in a hypercapnic patient; and a PaO₂ of 20.7 mmHg with an SpO₂ of 78% are discordant, so do not titrate on the saturation alone.

text.zh-CN: 立即气管插管行有创通气，无需顾及气漏或治疗目标
text.en: Intubate immediately for invasive ventilation, without regard to the air leak or goals of care

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。有创通气可能合适，但须先核对气漏（正压可加重气胸）并与患者/家属讨论治疗目标；在终末期纤维化中盲目插管未必获益。
feedback.en: Wrong. Invasive ventilation may be appropriate, but first check the air leak (positive pressure can worsen a pneumothorax) and discuss goals of care; blind intubation in end-stage fibrosis may not help.

prompt.zh-CN: 如何在不夸大证据的前提下处理这次严重恶化？
prompt.en: How should this severe deterioration be managed without overstating the evidence?

need.zh-CN: 先作出诊断决策，调阅本阶段的血常规/炎症指标，并采集已用治疗史。
need.en: First make the diagnosis decision, review this phase's blood count/markers and take the history of treatment already given.

text.zh-CN: 紧急重症与呼吸专科评估通气、可逆诱因与治疗目标，控制感染；中药不能替代呼吸支持，改善也不能归因于某一药物
text.en: Urgent critical-care and respiratory review of ventilation, reversible contributors and goals of care, with infection control; herbal treatment must not replace respiratory support, and any improvement cannot be attributed to a single agent

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。多种措施同期使用，无法归因；报告复查明确纤维化同前。应以循证的呼吸支持与感染控制为主，并与患者/家属讨论治疗目标。
feedback.en: Correct. With many measures used together, nothing can be attributed; follow-up explicitly described unchanged fibrosis. Lead with evidence-based respiratory support and infection control, and discuss goals of care with the patient/family.

text.zh-CN: 照搬高剂量含附子（黑顺片60克）的破格救心汤，并认定它逆转了肺纤维化
text.en: Copy the high-dose aconite-containing 破格救心汤 (黑顺片 60 g) and conclude it reversed the fibrosis

feedback.zh-CN: 错误且不安全。附子（黑顺片为其炮制品）含乌头类生物碱，有毒、须久煎，过量可致心律失常与死亡；在低氧酸血症合并肺源性心脏病者风险叠加。且复查明确纤维化同前，改善是急性炎症的吸收，并非纤维化逆转；多药同用无法归因。
feedback.en: Wrong and unsafe. Aconite (黑顺片 is its processed form) contains toxic aconite alkaloids, must be decocted long, and in overdose can cause arrhythmia and death; the risk is compounded in hypoxic, acidaemic cor pulmonale. The follow-up explicitly showed unchanged fibrosis — the improvement was resolution of acute inflammation, not reversal of fibrosis; and the concurrent drugs preclude attribution.

text.zh-CN: 把大剂量激素作为唯一确证有效的治疗
text.en: Make high-dose corticosteroids the sole proven treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。激素在特发性肺纤维化急性加重中的证据有限，不能作为唯一确证有效的治疗；且需与感染、血糖、免疫抑制风险权衡。
feedback.en: Wrong. The evidence for steroids in AE-IPF is limited; they cannot be the sole proven treatment and must be balanced against infection, glucose and immunosuppression risks.

text.zh-CN: 既然真菌多为定植，停用全部抗感染药物
text.en: Since the fungi are mostly colonisers, stop all antimicrobials

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。合并细菌感染（中性粒细胞比例 89.8%、CRP升高、嗜麦芽窄食单胞菌）仍需抗菌治疗；定植不等于无需任何抗感染。
feedback.en: Wrong. A bacterial infection (neutrophils 89.8%, raised CRP, Stenotrophomonas maltophilia) still needs treatment; colonisation does not mean no antimicrobials at all.

text.zh-CN: 采集主诉、活动能力、既往肺病与本次已用治疗
text.en: Elicited the presenting complaint, activity tolerance, past lung disease and treatment already given

text.zh-CN: 核对一般情况、肺部与生命体征
text.en: Checked the general appearance, chest and vital signs

text.zh-CN: 解读连续血气，识别急性-慢性高碳酸血症失代偿
text.en: Interpreted the serial blood gases and recognised acute-on-chronic hypercapnic decompensation

text.zh-CN: 在继续正压通气前注意到胸部CT图注的气漏
text.en: Noted the air leak in the CT caption before continuing positive-pressure ventilation

text.zh-CN: 正确框定当前评估
text.en: Framed the current assessment correctly

text.zh-CN: 区分真菌定植与侵袭性真菌病
text.en: Distinguished fungal colonisation from invasive fungal disease

text.zh-CN: 识别无创通气失败并在升级前权衡气漏与治疗目标
text.en: Recognised NIV failure and weighed the air leak and goals of care before escalation

text.zh-CN: 循证处理且不夸大单例证据
text.en: Managed on the evidence without overstating the single case

text.zh-CN: 未以高剂量附子汤剂替代呼吸支持作为主要救治
text.en: Did not use the high-dose aconite decoction as the primary rescue in place of respiratory support

text.zh-CN: 在特发性肺纤维化急性加重中与家属开展治疗目标讨论
text.en: Held a goals-of-care discussion with the family in AE-IPF

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 学员是否在升级（尤其有创通气）前，用通俗语言与家属讨论预后与治疗目标、了解患者意愿，并诚实说明特发性肺纤维化急性加重预后差、单例多药无法归因、不以中药替代呼吸支持。
judgeGuidance.en: Did the learner, before escalation (especially invasive ventilation), discuss prognosis and goals of care with the family in plain language and establish the patient's wishes, and state honestly that AE-IPF has a poor prognosis, that a single multi-drug case cannot attribute benefit, and that herbal treatment does not replace respiratory support?

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学（中西医结合专栏）。先核对当前阶段证据，再讨论鉴别与安全计划。关键点：连续血气显示急性-慢性高碳酸血症失代偿与无创通气失败；痰中真菌多为定植（EORTC/MSGERC 2020）；特发性肺纤维化急性加重预后差，有创升级前应讨论治疗目标；含附子的高剂量方剂涉及毒性与归因问题。原报告处置不自动成为今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: A historical teaching case (an integrative-medicine column). Review the current phase's evidence before the differential and a safe plan. Key points: the serial gases show acute-on-chronic hypercapnic decompensation and NIV failure; sputum fungi usually reflect colonisation (EORTC/MSGERC 2020); AE-IPF has a poor prognosis, so discuss goals of care before invasive escalation; the high-dose aconite-containing decoction raises toxicity and attribution issues. The report's care is not automatically a recommendation for today.

knowledge.zh-CN: 可就激素升级与中药安全提供用药信息：甲泼尼龙上调需注意感染、血糖与免疫抑制；破格救心汤含黑顺片（附子炮制品）60克，附子含乌头类生物碱，须先煎久煎，过量可致心律失常，60克应对照《中国药典》剂量范围；氟康唑无霉菌活性。仅就学员已获得的资料解释，不提供未记录数值或诊断。
knowledge.en: Can advise on steroid escalation and herbal safety: escalating methylprednisolone raises infection, glucose and immunosuppression concerns; the 破格救心汤 decoction contains 60 g of 黑顺片 (processed aconite), which holds toxic aconite alkaloids, must be decocted first and long, can cause arrhythmia in overdose, and whose 60 g should be checked against the Pharmacopoeia range; fluconazole has no mould activity. Explains only what the learner already has, with no unrecorded value or diagnosis.

title.zh-CN: 中西医结合治疗特发性肺纤维化合并肺炎：证据与安全复盘
title.en: Integrative management of IPF with pneumonia: evidence and safety debrief

conclusion.zh-CN: 本例为74岁男性、特发性肺纤维化9年合并肺部感染，入院数小时内由慢性代偿转为急性高碳酸血症呼吸失代偿（考虑特发性肺纤维化急性加重）。作者的西医诊断为特发性肺纤维化、真菌性肺炎、支气管哮喘、2型呼吸衰竭、慢性肺源性心脏病，中医诊断为肺痿（肺肾两虚、痰瘀互结型）。在无创通气、抗感染、激素升级的基础上加用含高剂量附子的破格救心汤。可核对的结局是急性炎症与症状改善、纤维化未变；合并多种同期治疗，无法证明某一药物（含中药或激素）的独立疗效。
conclusion.en: A 74-year-old man with 9 years of IPF and a lung infection who, within hours of admission, moved from chronic compensation to acute hypercapnic respiratory decompensation (AE-IPF was considered). The authors' Western diagnoses were IPF, fungal pneumonia, bronchial asthma, type 2 respiratory failure and chronic cor pulmonale, and the TCM diagnosis was 肺痿 (lung-kidney deficiency with phlegm-stasis). On top of non-invasive ventilation, antimicrobials and corticosteroid escalation, a high-dose aconite-containing 破格救心汤 decoction was added. The verifiable endpoint is improvement in acute inflammation and symptoms with unchanged fibrosis; with many concurrent treatments, no single agent (herbal or steroid) can be shown to work on its own.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 入院 pH 7.430、PaCO₂ 56.3、HCO₃⁻ 37.4 为慢性代偿的高碳酸血症（另有代谢性碱中毒成分）；5小时后 pH 7.149、PaCO₂ 118.5 提示急性加重及无创通气失败。连续血气比单次体温更能显示危急程度。
keyReasoning.en: Admission pH 7.430, PaCO₂ 56.3 mmHg and HCO₃⁻ 37.4 mmol/L show compensated chronic hypercapnia with an added metabolic alkalosis; five hours later pH 7.149 with PaCO₂ 118.5 mmHg shows acute-on-chronic failure despite NIV. The serial gases, not a single temperature, show the severity.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 痰中酵母样真菌及菌丝多为定植；确诊侵袭性真菌病需组织或无菌部位证据（EORTC/MSGERC 2020）。
keyReasoning.en: Sputum yeast and hyphae usually reflect colonisation; proven invasive fungal disease needs tissue or sterile-site evidence (EORTC/MSGERC 2020).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 影像图注示少量气胸与皮下/纵隔气肿，正压通气前须核对该气漏；特发性肺纤维化急性加重预后差，有创升级前应讨论治疗目标。
keyReasoning.en: The imaging caption shows a small pneumothorax and subcutaneous/mediastinal emphysema, to be checked before positive-pressure ventilation; AE-IPF carries a poor prognosis, so discuss goals of care before invasive escalation.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例回顾，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。原报告同期使用抗感染、激素、雾化、无创通气与多种中药，无法区分各自贡献；可核对的终点仅为急性炎症吸收与症状改善，纤维化同前。历史处置仅作记录，不作疗效或安全性背书；决策与安全评分为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This is a single retrospective case and cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of any treatment. The report used antimicrobials, steroids, nebulisers, non-invasive ventilation and several herbal medicines together, so their separate contributions cannot be told apart; the only verifiable endpoints are resolution of acute inflammation and symptomatic improvement, with fibrosis unchanged. Historical care is recorded only, with no efficacy or safety endorsement; decisions and safety scoring are educational design.

unknowns.zh-CN: 气胸/气漏的出现时间与处理、无创通气参数、是否曾行有创通气。
unknowns.en: When the pneumothorax/air leak appeared and how it was handled, the NIV settings, and whether invasive ventilation was ever used.

unknowns.zh-CN: CT相对于5小时恶化的时间、详细药敏、侵袭性真菌病的进一步证据、右心评估与肺动脉压。
unknowns.en: The CT's timing relative to the 5-hour deterioration, detailed susceptibilities, further evidence of invasive fungal disease, and the right-heart assessment and pulmonary pressure.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院前治疗是否在外院开始、长期随访结局、SpO₂与PaO₂不符的原因（标本类型未说明）。
unknowns.en: Whether the pre-admission treatment began at another hospital, the long-term outcome, and the reason for the SpO₂–PaO₂ discordance (the sample type is not stated).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 急性加重框架。按 2016 国际工作组报告，特发性肺纤维化急性加重定义已修订，涵盖诱因明确（如感染）与原因不明的急性呼吸恶化；本例高碳酸血症对特发性肺纤维化并不典型，应搜寻其他病因（气道疾病——作者诊断了哮喘；无创通气失败；图注的气漏）。
teachingPoints.en: The exacerbation framework. The 2016 International Working Group revised the definition of acute exacerbation of IPF to cover both triggered (e.g. infection) and unexplained acute respiratory worsening; the hypercapnia here is atypical for IPF and should prompt a search for other causes (airway disease — the authors diagnosed asthma; NIV failure; the air leak in the caption).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 连续血气与无创通气失败。入院为慢性代偿高碳酸血症，5小时后急性失代偿（pH 7.149、PaCO₂ 118.5 mmHg）即为无创通气失败，须重新评估呼吸支持与治疗目标。
teachingPoints.en: Serial gases and NIV failure. Admission showed compensated chronic hypercapnia; acute decompensation at 5 hours (pH 7.149, PaCO₂ 118.5 mmHg) is NIV failure and demands a reassessment of respiratory support and goals of care.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 定植与侵袭性真菌病。痰中真菌多为定植；EORTC/MSGERC 2020 要求组织或无菌部位证据方可确诊侵袭性真菌病（该框架针对免疫抑制宿主，但在使用激素时有参考意义）。原报告由伏立康唑改为氟康唑——氟康唑无霉菌活性，若为霉菌则覆盖不足。
teachingPoints.en: Colonisation vs invasive fungal disease. Sputum fungi usually reflect colonisation; EORTC/MSGERC 2020 requires tissue or sterile-site evidence to confirm invasive fungal disease (a framework for immunocompromised hosts, but relevant under corticosteroids). The report switched from voriconazole to fluconazole — fluconazole has no mould activity, so cover would be insufficient if a mould were involved.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 治疗目标。特发性肺纤维化为进行性不可逆病变，急性加重预后差；在有创通气等升级前应与患者/家属讨论治疗目标与意愿。
teachingPoints.en: Goals of care. IPF is progressive and irreversible and its acute exacerbation carries a poor prognosis; discuss goals of care and the patient's wishes before escalation such as invasive ventilation.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 附子安全与单例归因。破格救心汤含黑顺片（附子炮制品）60克；附子含乌头类生物碱，有毒、须先煎久煎，过量可致麻痹、心律失常甚至死亡（香港卫生署中药材中毒警示），60克应对照《中国药典》2020年版「附子」剂量范围（本版未在线核实）。在低氧、酸血症合并肺源性心脏病者，心律失常风险叠加。可核对的结局是炎症吸收与症状改善、纤维化未变，且在激素、抗菌与无创通气并用下取得——单例多药无法归因于附子方剂，更不能据此认定其逆转纤维化。
teachingPoints.en: Aconite safety and single-case attribution. The 破格救心汤 decoction contains 60 g of 黑顺片 (processed aconite); aconite holds toxic aconite alkaloids, must be decocted first and long, and in overdose can cause paralysis, arrhythmia and even death (Hong Kong Department of Health herbal poisoning alert), and the 60 g should be checked against the dose range for 附子 in the 2020 Chinese Pharmacopoeia (not verified for this edition online). In a hypoxic, acidaemic patient with cor pulmonale the arrhythmia risk is compounded. The verifiable outcome — resolution of inflammation and symptoms with unchanged fibrosis — was obtained under concurrent steroids, antimicrobials and non-invasive ventilation, so a single multi-drug case cannot attribute it to the aconite decoction, let alone claim it reversed the fibrosis.
